entries.en: Added `modelOverrides` setting to map model picker entries to custom provider model IDs (e.g. Bedrock inference profile ARNs)
entries.zh: 添加了`modelOverrides`设置，以将模型选择器条目映射到自定义提供程序模型 ID（例如 Bedrock 推理配置文件 ARN）

entries.en: Added actionable guidance when OAuth login or connectivity checks fail due to SSL certificate errors (corporate proxies, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`)
entries.zh: 添加了当 OAuth 登录或连接检查由于 SSL 证书错误而失败时的可操作指南（公司代理，`NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`）

entries.en: Improved Up arrow after interrupting Claude — now restores the interrupted prompt and rewinds the conversation in one step
entries.zh: 改进：中断 Claude 后按上方向键，现在会一步完成：恢复被中断的提示词，并回退对话

entries.en: Improved IDE detection speed at startup
entries.zh: 改进启动时的 IDE 检测速度

entries.en: Improved clipboard image pasting performance on macOS
entries.zh: 改进 macOS 上粘贴剪贴板图片的性能

entries.en: Improved `/effort` to work while Claude is responding, matching `/model` behavior
entries.zh: 改进 `/effort`：Claude 回复时也能使用，与 `/model` 的行为一致

entries.en: Improved voice mode to automatically retry transient connection failures during rapid push-to-talk re-press
entries.zh: 改进语音模式：快速重复按下按键说话时，遇到短暂的连接失败会自动重试

entries.en: Improved the Remote Control spawn mode selection prompt with better context
entries.zh: 改进 Remote Control 启动方式选择提示，增加了更多上下文说明

entries.en: Changed default Opus model on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry to Opus 4.6 (was Opus 4.1)
entries.zh: 将 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Microsoft Foundry 上的默认 Opus 模型更改为 Opus 4.6（原为 Opus 4.1）

entries.en: Fixed freezes and 100% CPU loops triggered by permission prompts for complex bash commands
entries.zh: 修复了复杂 bash 命令的权限提示触发的冻结和 100% CPU 循环

entries.en: Fixed a deadlock that could freeze Claude Code when many skill files changed at once (e.g. during `git pull` in a repo with a large `.claude/skills/` directory)
entries.zh: 修复了当许多技能文件同时更改时可能冻结克劳德代码的死锁（例如，在具有大型`.claude/skills/`目录的存储库中的`git pull`期间）

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool output being lost when running multiple Claude Code sessions in the same project directory
entries.zh: 修复了在同一项目目录中运行多个 Claude Code 会话时 Bash 工具输出丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents with `model: opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` being silently downgraded to older model versions on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry
entries.zh: 修复了`model: opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku`的子代理在 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Microsoft Foundry 上默默降级为旧模型版本的问题

entries.en: Fixed background bash processes spawned by subagents not being cleaned up when the agent exits
entries.zh: 修复了代理退出时子代理生成的后台 bash 进程未被清理的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` showing the current session in the picker
entries.zh: 修复了在选择器中显示当前会话的`/resume`

entries.en: Fixed `/ide` crashing with `onInstall is not defined` when auto-installing the extension
entries.zh: 修复了自动安装扩展时`/ide`因“onInstall is not Defined”而崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/loop` not being available on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry and when telemetry was disabled
entries.zh: 修复了`/loop`在基岩/顶点/铸造厂上以及禁用遥测时不可用的问题

entries.en: Fixed SessionStart hooks firing twice when resuming a session via `--resume` or `--continue`
entries.zh: 修复了通过`--resume`或`--continue`恢复会话时 SessionStart 挂钩触发两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed JSON-output hooks injecting no-op system-reminder messages into the model's context on every turn
entries.zh: 修复了 JSON 输出挂钩，每次都会将无操作系统提醒消息注入到模型的上下文中

entries.en: Fixed voice mode session corruption when a slow connection overlaps a new recording
entries.zh: 修复慢速连接与新录音重叠时，语音模式会话损坏的问题

entries.en: Fixed Linux sandbox failing to start with "ripgrep (rg) not found" on native builds
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 沙箱在本机构建上无法启动并出现“ripgrep (rg) not found”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Linux native modules not loading on Amazon Linux 2 and other glibc 2.26 systems
entries.zh: 修复了在 Amazon Linux 2 和其他 glibc 2.26 系统上无法加载的 Linux 本机模块

entries.en: Fixed "media_type: Field required" API error when receiving images via Remote Control
entries.zh: 修复了通过远程控制接收图像时“media_type: Field required”API 错误

entries.en: Fixed `/heapdump` failing on Windows with `EEXIST` error when the Desktop folder already exists
entries.zh: 修复了当桌面文件夹已存在时`/heapdump`在 Windows 上失败并出现`EEXIST`错误的问题

entries.en: VSCode: Fixed HTTP 400 errors for users behind proxies or on Bedrock/Vertex with Claude 4.5 models
entries.zh: VS Code：修复了用户位于代理后，或在 Bedrock/Vertex 上使用 Claude 4.5 模型时出现的 HTTP 400 错误

entries.en: Deprecated `/output-style` command — use `/config` instead. Output style is now fixed at session start for better prompt caching
entries.zh: 已弃用的`/output-style`命令 - 使用`/config`代替。现在在会话开始时固定输出样式，以实现更好的提示缓存
